troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting: No Audio in Recording
troubleshooting.shortdesc: The recorded file has video but no sound.

condition.p: Playing back a finished recording produces picture with no audio track, or with a track that is silent.

cause.p: The audio source was muted, or its volume fader was at zero, at the time of recording. Muting in the Audio Mixer is captured—OBS Studio records exactly what you would hear.

step.cmd: Check the Audio Mixer for a muted icon on the relevant source.
Unmute the source and confirm the fader is above zero.
Record a short test clip and play it back before recording anything longer.

cause.p: The wrong audio device is assigned as the global Desktop Audio or Mic/Auxiliary device in Settings, so the intended device was never being captured at all.

step.cmd: Confirm the correct devices are selected for Desktop Audio and Mic/Auxiliary Audio.
